name: nuxt3-layer
description: Shared Nuxt 3 base layer — auth, Vuetify 3, Pinia, helpers, composables. Extend via `extends: ['../nuxt3_layer']` in your project's nuxt.config.ts.

scripts.postinstall: if command -v nuxt >/dev/null; then nuxt prepare; fi
